# achu — extended summary for AI systems

> Free, open-source screenshot beautifier for Windows, macOS, and Linux with local gallery, privacy redaction, OCR, and AI-powered GitHub issue drafting.

## One-sentence answers (AEO)

**What is achu?** A local-first desktop app that beautifies screenshots, saves them to a gallery on your disk, redacts secrets, extracts text, and drafts GitHub issues with AI.

**Who is achu for?** Developers, QA engineers, technical writers, and anyone who shares polished screenshots or bug reports.

**Is achu free?** Yes, MIT-licensed and free to download from GitHub Releases.

**Where are gallery screenshots stored?** In a user-chosen folder on disk; default is `~/achu-screenshots` (home directory). No cloud sync.

**How do I save to the gallery?** Beautify a screenshot in the editor, then click the Gallery button in the workspace footer.

**How do I open the gallery?** Click the grid icon in the left toolbar.

**Are deleted gallery files recoverable?** Yes, for up to 30 days in `.achu-trash` inside the gallery folder; then auto-purged.

## Feature details

### Canvas and framing
- Padding, rounded corners, inset, border, shadow, scale
- Backgrounds: solid, gradient, blur, mesh gradient with editable control points
- Browser chrome overlays (macOS and Windows styles)
- Aspect ratio presets and custom canvas dimensions
- Watermark support
- Export: PNG, JPEG, WebP with quality controls

### Local Screenshot Gallery
- Save beautified exports directly to gallery folder
- Thumbnail grid with file name, size, and modified date
- Actions: open in editor (preserves current annotations), copy to clipboard, reveal in file explorer, delete (soft)
- Settings: browse and set custom gallery folder
- Trash: `.achu-trash` subfolder, 30-day retention, automatic purge on gallery list

### Smart Privacy Guard
- Local Tesseract WASM scan for credentials, API keys, emails, IPs, cards, phones
- Per-item toggle or redact-all
- Gaussian blur or solid mask redaction styles

### AI Issue Agent
- Vision LLM analyzes screenshot → structured GitHub issue (title, body, labels, context)
- Providers: Ollama (offline), Gemini, OpenAI, Claude
- GitHub PAT stored with OS keychain via Electron safeStorage
- User reviews before submit

### OCR text grabber
- Right-click canvas → extract text modal
- Edit, trim, copy — 100% local WASM

### Annotations
- Tools: pointer, rectangles, circles, lines, arrows, text, pen, emoji
- Undo/redo, custom fonts, stroke width, colors

## Privacy model

- Default: all image processing local
- Gallery files: never uploaded by the app
- AI Issue Agent: only sends data you approve when using a configured external API
- GitHub integration: uses your token for issues you submit
